fields.description: Weekly issue containing editorials and local commentary on Miami’s return to two-way downtown traffic and anticipated accidents; discussion of wages and working conditions (including teacher pay) and employment for women; coverage of civic and political matters including Governor John W. Martin’s criticism of Dade County and local reform efforts; notes on tourism promotion and Herbert Hoover’s reported visit; entertainment and nightlife listings and advertisements (theaters, clubs, hotels); items on greyhound/dog racing promotion; letters and reports concerning sanitation and street conditions in Miami Beach, and a Fort Myers dispute with Florida Power & Light over franchise and rates; and a column on a labor dispute involving the Capitol theatre.
